key_insight: MS-Exam-Gen is a reproducible, source-grounded workflow for building and auditing a text-only multiple-choice benchmark to test LLM knowledge of multiple sclerosis MRI topics.
clinical_relevance: It supports safer evaluation of biomedical LLMs on current MS-MRI criteria, reporting, and differential diagnosis knowledge, but it is not a clinical diagnostic tool.
method: Indexed 66 expert sources into 4,289 retrieval chunks
Generated and locked a 3,058-item candidate benchmark across 16 topics and 53 subtopics
Used evidence-grounded MCQ generation plus automated quality audits and consistency screening
evidence_signal: Across 12 LLM endpoints, the benchmark produced 36,696 item-level predictions and revealed a wide accuracy spread from 89.7% to 46.9%.
watch_item: Construction labels are metadata only, and the benchmark is not clinically certified; expert adjudication and full option-order counterbalancing were not yet completed.
paper_title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
